(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (crop-cells base cells)
      (let* ((bb (bbox-of-cells cells))
             (r0 (first bb)) (c0 (second bb))
             (r1 (third bb)) (c1 (fourth bb)))
        (grid-from-fn (+ 1 (- r1 r0)) (+ 1 (- c1 c0))
          (lambda (r c)
            (let ((rr (+ r0 r)) (cc (+ c0 c)))
              (if (member? (list rr cc) cells) (at base rr cc) 0))))))
    (define (paste-nonzero out pat top left)
      (for*/fold ([acc out])
                 ([r (in-range (rows pat))]
                  [c (in-range (cols pat))]
                  #:when (not (= (at pat r c) 0)))
        (let ((rr (+ top r)) (cc (+ left c)))
          (if (in-bounds? rr cc (rows acc) (cols acc))
              (set-cell acc rr cc (at pat r c))
              acc))))
    (let* ((template-cells
             (connected-region g 0 0
               (lambda (r c v) (and (not (= v 0)) (not (= v 8))))
               4))
           (template (crop-cells g template-cells))
           (anchors (find-color g 8)))
      (for/fold ([out (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0)])
                ([anchor (in-list anchors)])
        (paste-nonzero out template (first anchor) (second anchor))))))
